sn38.9:1.7: “But, reverend, what path and what practice, for giving up that ignorance?”
sn38.9:1.8: “Reverend, it is simply this noble eightfold path for giving up that ignorance, that is—
sn38.9:1.10: Reverend, this is the path, this is the practice, for giving up that ignorance.”
sn38.9:1.11: “Reverend, this is a fine path, a fine practice, for giving up that ignorance.
sn38.9:1.12: And just this much is enough for diligence, Reverend Sāriputta.”
